notes.text:
**Changes requested** (after attempt 1): The work is right and reviewed — this is catch-up only. Do not reopen any decision.

The branch conflicts with main. Since it was cut, two siblings landed on the same files:

  9bada4c  #237  adds `case 'edit'` to src/cli.js (the HELP block and a new case), and edits
                 docs/wiki/features/backlog-grooming.md
  (latest)  #140  adds installStamp() and the upgrade check to src/dispatch.js

`gh pr update-branch` refused with 422 "merge conflict between base and head", so this needs a real merge.

Merge `origin/main` into the branch — never rebase, never force-push, the branch is already pushed — and keep
both sides:

- **src/cli.js**: #237's `edit` case and HELP lines stay; your `--triage-only` flag on the `promote` case stays.
  They are different cases in the same switch and different lines in the same HELP block.
- **docs/wiki/features/backlog-grooming.md**: #237 rewrote part of it because `hkb edit` now exists. Your change
  removes the `promote --triage-only` gap note for the same reason. Both notes should end up gone and the page
  should describe both verbs as shipped — read what is on main before you edit, do not restore the old text.
- **skills/kanban/SKILL.md**: your apply-step change stays.

Then `npm run lint && npm test` — the suite is at 972 on current main, so expect that plus nothing new; you are
not adding tests in this pass.

**Merged by the operator seat** — review: Reviewed at attempt 1 and re-verified after the catch-up merge at attempt 3; the work never changed, only its base. The guard fires where the card asked — promote(ctx, n, {triageOnly}) returns a skipped row naming the status it actually found BEFORE resolveTrack and before any read or write. The failure it closes is subtle and worth stating: a todo root has no open blockers of its own, so allowForce was true and promoting an already-moved card silently FORCED it to ready, detectable only by noticing a forced line in the output afterwards. Now a batch mixing triage and already-moved cards produces one clean report, using the same skipped-row shape formatPromote already groups. Three tests, each named for the card: the CLI flag end to end, the guard firing before anything is written, and the flag being a no-op on a card genuinely still in triage. Catch-up verified specifically, since two siblings had landed on the same files: case 'edit' from #237 survives in src/cli.js alongside this card's --triage-only on the promote case, and the wiki page's obsolete gap notes for both verbs are gone while the genuine remaining gap (no close-as-duplicate verb, #193) stays. CI green, lint clean, 980 tests. Process note: hkb merge refused this PR outright with 'Pull Request has merge conflicts' rather than forcing, and gh pr update-branch then declined with 422 'merge conflict between base and head' — the cheap rung correctly saying it cannot help before a worker session was spent, which is the ladder #214 specifies. This closes the second half of amendment 6, the two verbs I failed to assign to any child when I decomposed #191., checks: green, method: squash
